name: How does hard water affect water heater maintenance in the Las Vegas area?

mainEntity.name: How does hard water affect water heater maintenance in the Las Vegas area?

acceptedAnswer.text: The Las Vegas area is known for its hard water, which contains high levels of minerals like calcium and magnesium. These minerals can accumulate as sediment at the bottom of your water heater tank, reducing its efficiency and lifespan. Regular annual flushing is crucial in our service areas like Las Vegas, Henderson, and Summerlin to remove this buildup, prevent damage to heating elements, and maintain energy efficiency. Neglecting this can lead to higher utility bills and premature unit failure.
acceptedAnswer.description: Hard water in Las Vegas causes mineral buildup, necessitating annual flushing during maintenance to prevent efficiency loss and damage to the water heater.
